summary:
Following the events of their first case together and the TRIBUNAL, Kim Kitsuragi ends up nursing what he thinks is more than a simple concussion. He transfers out of the 57th and joins his disco partner-in-crime at what they both do best. And if there's an art heist gone wrong, a roadtrip through Revachol, and some psychic heart-to-hearts along the way, who can blame him?
Or: For some reason he now has VOICES in his head. Not only that, but it seems... Harry can hear them too?
Edit: If you like this work, I totally recommend checking out Sensorium by MaskofSilver <3
